scientific_integrity: The update is an explicitly defined new independent-edge random Volterra model motivated by stochastic-operator dynamics, not a theorem attributed to the source literature. Its analytic martingale argument establishes the infinite-time claims; exact-rational finite checks only corroborate algebraic identities.
scientific_limitations: Finite simplex; independent centered bounded edge noise, iid generations, and a uniform coefficient bound below 1. The stationary-support result is exact, but incomplete-graph hitting laws are not fully determined. Independent validation and an exhaustive priority assessment have not been performed.
title: The variance-graph theorem for unbiased random Volterra population maps
